description: TM-score test of AcrIF3 structural mimicry of Cas8f, with Cas7f and Cas5f as negative controls
code:
import requests, numpy as np, time
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({"User-Agent":"research/1.0"})
AA3={'ALA','ARG','ASN','ASP','CYS','GLN','GLU','GLY','HIS','ILE','LEU','LYS','MET','PHE','PRO','SER','THR','TRP','TYR','VAL','MSE'}
def parse(t):
    L=t.splitlines(); i=0; cols=[]; rows=[]; n=len(L)
    while i<n:
        if L[i].startswith('_atom_site.'):
            while i<n and L[i].startswith('_atom_site.'): cols.append(L[i].strip().split('.')[1]); i+=1
            while i<n:
                ln=L[i]
                if ln.startswith('#') or ln.startswith('loop_') or ln.startswith('_') or ln.strip()=='': break
                rows.append(ln.split()); i+=1
            break
        i+=1
    idx={c:k for k,c in enumerate(cols)}; return idx,[r for r in rows if len(r)==len(cols)]
def cas(pid,chain):
    idx,recs=parse(S.get(f"https://files.rcsb.org/download/{pid}.cif",timeout=200).text)
    d={}
    for r in recs:
        if r[idx['auth_asym_id']]==chain and r[idx['label_atom_id']]=='CA' and r[idx['label_comp_id']] in AA3:
            d[int(r[idx['auth_seq_id']])]=[float(r[idx['Cartn_x']]),float(r[idx['Cartn_y']]),float(r[idx['Cartn_z']])]
    ks=sorted(d); return np.array(ks), np.array([d[k] for k in ks])
def kabsch(P,Q):
    pc=P.mean(0);qc=Q.mean(0);V,s,Wt=np.linalg.svd((P-pc).T@(Q-qc))
    dd=np.sign(np.linalg.det(V@Wt)); return V@np.diag([1,1,dd])@Wt,pc,qc
def app(X,R,pc,qc): return (X-pc)@R+qc

def dp_align(Sm, gap=-0.6):
    n,m=Sm.shape
    H=np.zeros((n+1,m+1)); P=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    for i in range(1,n+1): H[i,0]=H[i-1,0]+gap; P[i,0]=1
    for j in range(1,m+1): H[0,j]=H[0,j-1]+gap; P[0,j]=2
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        s=Sm[i-1]; Hi=H[i]; Hi1=H[i-1]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            a=Hi1[j-1]+s[j-1]; b=Hi1[j]+gap; c=Hi[j-1]+gap
            if a>=b and a>=c: Hi[j]=a; P[i,j]=0
            elif b>=c: Hi[j]=b; P[i,j]=1
            else: Hi[j]=c; P[i,j]=2
    i,j=n,m; pairs=[]
    while i>0 and j>0:
        p=P[i,j]
        if p==0: pairs.append((i-1,j-1)); i-=1; j-=1
        elif p==1: i-=1
        else: j-=1
    pairs.reverse(); return pairs

def tmscore_search(Q,T,label,nseed=30,FL=10):
    Lq=len(Q); d0=max(0.5,1.24*(Lq-15)**(1/3)-1.8)
    tree=cKDTree(T); cands=[]
    for i in range(0,Lq-FL,2):
        P0=Q[i:i+FL]
        for j in range(0,len(T)-FL,2):
            R,pc,qc=kabsch(P0,T[j:j+FL])
            d,_=tree.query(app(Q,R,pc,qc))
            cands.append((int((d<5.0).sum()),R,pc,qc))
    cands.sort(key=lambda x:-x[0]); best=(0,None)
    for n0,R,pc,qc in cands[:nseed]:
        for it in range(4):
            M=app(Q,R,pc,qc)
            D=np.linalg.norm(M[:,None,:]-T[None,:,:],axis=2)
            Sm=1.0/(1.0+(D/d0)**2)
            prs=dp_align(Sm)
            if len(prs)<8: break
            pi=np.array([p[0] for p in prs]); pj=np.array([p[1] for p in prs])
            # keep only close pairs for the fit
            dd=D[pi,pj]; sel=dd<8.0
            if sel.sum()<8: break
            R,pc,qc=kabsch(Q[pi[sel]],T[pj[sel]])
            M=app(Q,R,pc,qc)
            tm=(1.0/(1.0+(np.linalg.norm(M[pi]-T[pj],axis=1)/d0)**2)).sum()/Lq
            if tm>best[0]:
                nal=int((np.linalg.norm(M[pi]-T[pj],axis=1)<5).sum())
                rmsd=float(np.sqrt((np.linalg.norm(M[pi]-T[pj],axis=1)[np.linalg.norm(M[pi]-T[pj],axis=1)<5]**2).mean()))
                best=(tm,(nal,rmsd,pi,pj,R,pc,qc))
    print(f"{label}: TM-score (norm. by AcrIF3 length {Lq}) = {best[0]:.3f}; aligned pairs <5A = {best[1][0]}, RMSD {best[1][1]:.2f} A")
    return best

t0=time.time()
kq,Q=cas("5GNF","A")
targets={"PA14 Cas8f (Csy1, 6NE0 chain A)":("6NE0","A"),
         "PA14 Cas7f (Csy3, 6NE0 chain C) control":("6NE0","C"),
         "PA14 Cas5f (Csy2, 6NE0 chain B) control":("6NE0","B")}
out={}
for lab,(pid,ch) in targets.items():
    kt,T=cas(pid,ch)
    out[lab]=tmscore_search(Q,T,lab)
print("elapsed",time.time()-t0)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8,4))
labs=list(out); vals=[out[l][0] for l in labs]
ax.barh(range(len(labs)),vals,color=["#2E6F95","0.75","0.75"])
ax.set_yticks(range(len(labs))); ax.set_yticklabels([l.replace(" control","") for l in labs],fontsize=9)
ax.axvline(0.5,ls="--",color="#C8553D"); ax.text(0.505,2.3,"TM = 0.5 (same fold)",color="#C8553D",fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel("TM-score, normalised by AcrIF3 length (137 residues)")
ax.set_title("Is AcrIF3 a structural mimic of a Csy subunit?\nfragment-seeded rigid superposition with sequence-order-constrained matching",fontsize=10)
for s in ("top","right"): ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
